projectable_rg_authority.source: Barvinsky, Kurov, Sibiryakov, arXiv:2411.13574v1 / Phys. Rev. D 111, 024030 (2025)
facts: The 3+1 projectable marginal-coupling flow has asymptotically free UV fixed points.
A unique family of RG trajectories reaches the near-GR kinetic domain 0<lambda-1<<1.
The RG calculation intentionally retains the marginal sector; eta and mu_a are relevant deformations and are not jointly transported by that marginal flow.
The source explicitly states that reaching the proper IR domain is necessary but not sufficient because the full projectable IR theory has a long-wavelength scalar instability.

projectable_scattering_authority.source: Radkovski, Sibiryakov, arXiv:2306.00102 / Phys. Rev. D 108, 046017 (2023)
facts: Tree-level projectable Hořava 2->2 graviton amplitudes are finite at lambda->infinity at fixed other marginal couplings.
The auxiliary-field action makes the lambda=infinity limit manifestly regular.
Appendix D gives explicit head-on amplitudes including Eq. D.9 used in Iter350.
The source explicitly separates this high-energy result from the problematic projectable low-energy Minkowski vacuum.

projectable_ir_2026_authority.source: Mukohyama, Radkovski, Sibiryakov, arXiv:2604.09400 / Phys. Rev. D 114, 024039 (2026)
facts: Minkowski spacetime has an infrared instability in 3+1 projectable Hořava gravity.
A phenomenologically viable resolution must hide it through time-dependent processes such as Hubble/Jeans dynamics or find a low-average-curvature static endpoint.

The paper finds no static inhomogeneous quasiperiodic planar-symmetry endpoint supplied by higher-derivative terms and argues that the classified static solutions do not provide an endpoint for the Minkowski instability.
This motivates the still-open time-dependent resolution route.

nonprojectable_2026_authority.source: Blas, Del Porro, Herrero-Valea, Radkovski, Sibiryakov, arXiv:2512.14864 / Phys. Rev. D 113, 106022 (2026)
facts: A Lagrangian path-integral formulation for non-projectable Hořava gravity is constructed.
The explicit one-loop case study is in 2+1 dimensions and verifies cancellation of dangerous linear-in-frequency divergences in the studied two-point function.

The paper formulates additional questions that must be resolved to prove perturbative renormalizability of non-projectable Hořava gravity; it is not a 3+1 all-sector renormalizability/observable closure certificate.

frozen_interpretation.reason: The UV/marginal RG and scattering authorities do not jointly transport the relevant IR coefficients eta, mu_1, mu_2 and the time-dependent IR resolution into a normalized physical observable/comparator package.
